question: Harikrishnan A Ra becomes India’s ______ Grandmaster.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**87th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Harikrishnan A Ra becomes India’s 87th Grandmaster

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Harikrishnan A. Ra**, a **chess player from Chennai**, has become **India’s 87th Grandmaster**.

 
 
• 
 
Achieved his **final GM norm** on **July 11, 2025**, at the **La Plagne Chess Festival** in **France**.

 
 
• 
 
The milestone marks the end of a **7-year journey** that began when he became an **International Master**.

 
 
• 
 
Harikrishnan is **23 years old**.

 
 
• 
 
His achievement adds to India’s growing list of elite players in **international chess**.
